settings.question: Are these official jerseys?
settings.answer: Our jerseys are high-quality fan/replica kits. They are not official licensed products. They feature premium stitched badges, breathable fabric, and true-to-match designs at a fraction of the official price.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 7-15 business days within Europe. Portugal orders typically arrive in 7-10 days. You'll receive a tracking number once your order ships.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy. If the jersey doesn't fit or you're not happy, contact us and we'll sort it. Items must be unworn with tags attached.

settings.question: How do I pick the right size?
settings.answer: Check our size guide on each product page. We recommend measuring a jersey you already own and comparing. When in between sizes, go one size up.

settings.question: Do you ship outside Europe?
settings.answer: Currently we ship across the EU. We're working on expanding to the UK and Brazil. Sign up for our newsletter to be notified.

settings.question: Can I customise a jersey with a name and number?
settings.answer: Customisation options are coming soon. For now, we offer the standard club/team designs. Follow us on Instagram @twotrim for updates.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, MB Way, PayPal, and Apple Pay. All transactions are processed securely through Shopify Payments.
